actualImplementation: Read complete Session/Owner/Test diffs and actual Account.open/connect/signOut/storage boundaries. Same retained Client/Vault/transport/fresh provider are used. DEBUG-only exponent injection leaves production SecRandom unchanged.

Session installs its exact(id,Task) before the first await. Task includes real material verification and owner creation. It calls finish inside the worker on both terminal paths before releasing its result; outer cancellation targets that actual worker.

Cancel/logout drain the real worker result before acquiring busy and clearing Auth pending state. Epoch/operation identity denies an older drain after a new login/binding owns the actor. Confirmed account-save observations remain historical facts rather than fabricated rollback or current signing authority.

Owner cancellation/logout take a new operation UUID and retain isWorking. Old result/error/defer cannot overwrite the current outcome or clear a new operation. UI observations expose only checked account/challenge facts and logs contain error type, not password/token/key.

Every existing signing-context discard releases retained Auth and result before another await. App startup constructor performs no I/O and services nil still means unavailable; this change adds no user-facing login/provider.

Root found that first-login holdInit never reaches Account.connect and therefore never saves a credential Record. Original Client.signOut with absent record writes nothing. V1 test required a nonnil record and would fail on correct behavior. V2 changes only that assertion to exact nil; actual owner-state/peer-path/old-result checks stay intact. No production empty-record write was added.
